preview.what: Events, listeners, observers, broadcasting — decoupling side effects.
preview.picture: A bell rings when an order is placed; the kitchen, the SMS system, and the accounting sheet each react without the cashier knowing they exist.
preview.why: Asked as: 'how would you add an email on signup without touching the controller?'
preview.bn: Order হলে ঘণ্টা বাজে — kitchen, SMS, হিসাব সবাই সাড়া দেয়, cashier জানেই না তারা আছে।
